rationale: The description specifies a document-oriented database using JSON storage, JavaScript MapReduce queries, and an HTTP API—conventional database storage, processing, and access functions.
evidence_spans: an open-source document-oriented NoSQL database, implemented in Erlang. CouchDB uses multiple formats and protocols to store, transfer, and process its data. It uses JSON to store data, JavaScript as its query language using MapReduce, and HTTP for an API.
